metadata.description: The Azure region currently serving as primary (traffic will be redirected away from this region).
The Azure region to fail over to (will become the new primary).
Name of the Azure Traffic Manager profile to update endpoint weights on.
Resource group containing the Traffic Manager profile.
Traffic Manager endpoint name for the primary region (will be set to weight 0).
Traffic Manager endpoint name for the failover region (will be set to weight 100).
Label applied to the deployment and audit tags.

resources.name: [concat(parameters('trafficManagerProfileName'), '/', parameters('primaryEndpointName'))]
resources.comments: Disable primary region endpoint to redirect all traffic to failover region.

resources.name: [concat(parameters('trafficManagerProfileName'), '/', parameters('failoverEndpointName'))]
resources.comments: Enable failover region endpoint with full traffic weight.
